MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The SanDisk 32GB microSD card fits my repeated purchases of memory cards and adapters; a compatible spare would support equipment I already use.",
    "The USB hub and extension cables fit my card reader and other USB accessories by making those connections more convenient. They support an existing task."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and Blink security bundle do not address a need I have expressed. Buying a tablet and photography accessories does not mean I want voice assistants or home surveillance.",
    "The Fire HD 10 assumes I want to replace my Fire 7, while the streaming stick and earbuds introduce uses I am not currently shopping for.",
    "The Ethernet cables resemble my practical cable purchases, but six one-foot cables serve a different purpose from the USB charging, extension, and device connections I have needed."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as interest in a broader range of Amazon devices, although my follow-up purchases supported the tablet I already owned.",
    "My purchases of cameras, cables, and accessories seem to have been stretched into interest in electronics generally, without enough attention to what each item would help me do."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Memory cards, adapters, storage cases, and a card reader recur throughout my history, making compatible storage and transfer accessories especially relevant.",
    "Many of my purchases add a specific function to existing equipment: a mount, a replacement cable, a lens cap, or easier connection access. Connector type, fit, length, and intended use matter to me.",
    "Frequent accessory purchases do not mean I need another major device; I need a clear practical reason to add or replace one."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my storage and connection needs but extended that interest too broadly into unrelated devices and upgrades."
}
